name: FraudGuard – fraud prevention for WooCommerce
author: Invizo

sections.description:
FraudGuard will prevent fake orders and blacklist fraud customers of your store.

Stop losing money to chargebacks and fraud! FraudGuard analyzes each order in real-time, checking for common fraud indicators such as high-risk countries, address mismatches, and suspicious ordering patterns.

Key Features

  • Rule-Based Fraud Detection: Scans orders as they come in to identify potential fraud using customizable rules
  • Risk Scoring System: Assigns risk scores to orders based on multiple fraud indicators
  • Instant Admin Notifications: Receive immediate email alerts when suspicious orders are detected
  • High-Risk Country Detection: Flag orders from countries known for high rates of fraud
  • Address Verification: Identify mismatches between billing and shipping addresses
  • Customizable Rules: Configure which fraud indicators to check for based on your business needs
  • Order Status Control: Automatically hold suspicious orders for review
  • HPOS Compatible: Works with both traditional and High-Performance Order Storage
  • Detailed Fraud Reports: View which rules were triggered for each flagged order

How It Works

  1. When a new order is placed, FraudGuard checks it against your configured fraud rules
  2. If suspicious patterns are detected, the order is flagged with a risk score
  3. Store administrators receive immediate email notifications with order details
  4. Flagged orders can be held for review before processing

Who Needs FraudGuard?

  • WooCommerce store owners who want to reduce chargebacks
  • Businesses selling high-value products
  • Stores that ship internationally
  • Anyone who has experienced fraud losses
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/fraudguard-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > FraudGuard to configure your preferences
  4. Set up which fraud rules you want to enable and your notification preferences
sections.faq:
Will this plugin slow down my checkout process?

No. FraudGuard performs its analysis after the order is placed and does not affect the customer checkout experience.

Does FraudGuard work with all payment gateways?

Yes. FraudGuard is payment gateway agnostic and works with all WooCommerce payment methods.

Can I customize which orders are flagged as fraudulent?

Yes. You can adjust the risk threshold and enable/disable specific fraud detection rules to match your business requirements.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. FraudGuard only processes order data that is already collected by WooCommerce and does not collect any additional personal information.

Does this plugin use AI or machine learning?

No. FraudGuard uses rule-based detection methods that you configure. It doesn’t require any external AI services or machine learning algorithms.
